summary:
CucinaSmart AI iteration 5: all 4 NEW features + AI recipe extra validated end-to-end. Backend 9/9 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_features.py (~9s incl. Gemini). Frontend flows verified on mobile viewport (390x844) with chef@cucina.ai. No blocking bugs. Deprecation warnings only (shadow*/pointerEvents/expo-notifications web) — no red screens, no 5xx, no unhandled runtime errors.

Backend coverage (all PASS):
- Cucinato: POST /api/recipes/{id}/cooked with seeded pantry (Uova 6 pz exp+2d price 3.0, Farina 500 g) and recipe (Uova 2 pz, Farina 200 g, Sale q.b., Latte 200 ml):
  * 1st call {} → updated Uova left=4, Farina left=300, not_found=[Latte] (Sale q.b./staple correctly ignored), items_saved>=1 (Uova days_left<=3). Pantry GET reflects new qtys.
  * 2nd call {servings:4} (factor 2) → Uova 4→0 in finished + added_to_shopping; shopping list contains Uova with note starting 'Finito cucinando:'.
  * 3rd call → Uova stays at 0 (never negative).
  * Unknown recipe id → 404.
- Stats: GET /api/stats/waste (current month) returns recipes_cooked>=2, items_used>=2, items_saved>=2, money_saved>=6.00 (uses price 3.0). ?month=bad → 400. ?month=2020-01 → all zeros. Response includes month, recipes_cooked, items_used, items_saved, money_saved, expired_now, last_cooked.
- Search + Cookable: GET /api/recipes?q=farina returns both seeded recipes; each item has missing_count(int) + cookable(bool) + missing_names. Recipe with only Farina + Sale q.b. (staple) → cookable=true, missing_count=0. Recipe with Farina + Latte (missing) → cookable=false, missing_count>=1. ?cookable=true filter returns only cookable recipes.
- PATCH /api/recipes/{id}: updates title/ingredients/steps; qty passed as string "250" is normalized to number 250.0; whitespace in ingredient names is trimmed; steps preserved.
- POST /api/ai/recipe {query:'pasta alla carbonara'} (~10s real Gemini) → recipe with title, ingredients (all with normalized numeric qty and unit), steps>=3. {query:''} → 400.
- POST /api/pantry with price 2.5/3.0 persists price (verified via GET /api/pantry).

Frontend coverage (all PASS on mobile 390x844):
- Oggi: waste-stats testID card visible with stat-cooked=3, stat-saved=3, stat-money='8,50 €' after cooking. kpi-expiring does NOT list TEST_Riso_ok (qty=0) — confirms the filter excludes qty 0 items.
- Ricette tab (tab-ricette): search input recipe-search 'uova' shows recipes matching by ingredient with visible badges 'Fattibile' and 'Mancano N' (e.g. 'Mancano 1', 'Mancano 2'). Chip 'Con ciò che ho' filters (empty message flow reached correctly).
- Ricette AI: typing 'carbonara' shows testID ai-recipe-card 'Chiedi a Chef AI'; tap → ai-recipe-sheet opened with ai-recipe-title populated (Gemini responded in ~10s during test); ai-recipe-save saves and navigates to /recipe/<new-id>. ai-recipe-cancel present (code inspected).
- Recipe detail: edit-recipe (pencil) and cooked-btn both visible on detail; tap cooked-btn → cooked-result box shows 'Dispensa aggiornata 🍽️Usati: TEST_iter5_Uova_… −2 pz, TEST_iter5_Farina_… −200 g Non in dispensa: Latte 🎉 1 prodotto salvato dalla scadenza!' (all three requested lines present).
- edit-recipe: opens /add-recipe?id=<rid> with 'Modifica ricetta' header; testIDs ing-qty, ing-unit, ing-name, add-ing all present. Existing rows accessible via edit-ing-{i} (verified in code).
- Dispensa: add-pantry-fab opens sheet containing pantry-name, pantry-qty, pantry-unit, pantry-expires, pantry-price inputs. pantry-save saves; € persisted server-side. Also verified: scan-price testID exists in scanner UI (code review).
- Auth token key: 'cucinasmart_token' in localStorage (raw 64-char hex). Login via UI (Accedi) confirmed.
- Console: only expected shadow*/pointerEvents/expo-notifications web deprecation warnings. 'PAGE ERROR: Event' entries are the harmless Playwright resource-error propagation from 401s during unauthenticated navigation before login (verified — not a JS runtime error). No React red screens.
action_items: OPTIONAL LOW: The waste-stats card 'Anti-spreco' shows a warning subtitle 'Ottimo lavoro! Occhio però: 1 prodotto è già scaduto in dispensa.' when expired_now>0. That message from chef account is triggered by an old TEST_Pomodori_urgent left over from iter4. Not a bug — just noting seed data drift on the shared chef account.

OPTIONAL LOW: On Ricette the empty state for 'Con ciò che ho' does not explicitly mention 'dispensa' when qty=0. Current implementation shows 'Nessuna ricetta fattibile con la dispensa attuale.\nProva "Cosa cucino?" per idee AI.' which does mention 'dispensa' — meets spec. Ignore.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1134 lines — should be split into routers (auth, recipes, pantry, shopping, meals, stats, ai, storage, household). Recommendation carried over from iter4.

/api/recipes/{id}/cooked correctly guards against qty<0 via `max(0.0, cur - used)` (server.py:496) and only marks finished when `new_qty == 0 and used > 0` (server.py:503) preventing already-empty items from being re-added to shopping.
Search / cookable logic (_match_pantry, server.py:367) correctly ignores PANTRY_STAPLES and unit=='q.b.' — validated by test_search_by_ingredient_and_cookable_flag with Sale q.b.
PATCH /api/recipes/{rid} (server.py:427) sanitizes _id/id/user_id/household_id and normalizes ingredients via norm_ingredients — good.

Stats endpoint (server.py:515-536) uses monthly bucket via consumption_log.month field and DEFAULT_PRICE fallback of 2.5 — matches spec. Money uses per-use price, not per-item; consistent with items_saved being a count of uses.
ai/recipe uses gemini-3-flash-preview via emergentintegrations LlmChat — real Gemini call verified. len(qtxt)<2 returns 400 (matches empty query spec).
Frontend cooked-btn (recipe/[id].tsx) invalidates ['pantry','pantry-all','pantry-expiring','shopping','recipes','waste-stats'] on success — ensures Oggi/Dispensa/Spesa all refresh correctly.
seed_data_creation: Fresh isolated pytest users created per test class via /api/auth/signup (TEST_it5_<uuid>@cucinasmart.dev). Chef account (chef@cucina.ai) used for UI: added 1 pantry item TEST_iter5_Uova_<x> (fridge, +2d, price 3.0), 1 TEST_iter5_Farina_<x> (pantry, 500 g), 1 recipe TEST UI5 Frittata (rec_b0d0e1040eca). Cooked recipe multiple times to populate consumption_log/stats. Also created an AI-generated 'pasta alla carbonara' recipe via /api/ai/recipe → saved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter5 regression: /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_features.py runs in ~9s (independent of other suites — uses fresh signup users). Key testIDs to reuse: cooked-btn, cooked-result, edit-recipe (recipe/[id]), ing-qty/ing-unit/ing-name/add-ing/remove-ing-{i}/edit-ing-{i} (add-recipe), ai-recipe-card/ai-recipe-sheet/ai-recipe-title/ai-recipe-save/ai-recipe-cancel/recipe-search (ricette), waste-stats/stat-cooked/stat-saved/stat-money/kpi-expiring (oggi), pantry-price/pantry-name/pantry-qty/pantry-unit/pantry-expires/pantry-save/add-pantry-fab/scan-price (dispensa). Auth token key 'cucinasmart_token' in localStorage. UI login: locator('input').nth(0)=email, nth(1)=password, click 'Accedi' last match. Server date ~2026-09-26 (confirmed by 'Settembre 2026' in Anti-spreco card). BASE URL from EXPO_BACKEND_URL or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (both set to https://app-builder-14436.preview.emergentagent.com).
rca_of_issue: No bugs to root-cause. All 12 features/flows in the review request passed both backend (pytest 9/9) and frontend (playwright walkthrough) validation. The two 'FAIL' lines observed in the first playwright run were selector issues in the test script itself (using text=Ricette instead of [data-testid=tab-ricette] and not clicking add-pantry-fab), fixed in the second run and both flows subsequently passed.
